description: Start or stop dependency checks for an owned page. Requires an existing paid watch pass; never makes a new purchase. No separate charge. Without a pass in force, answers 409 dependency_watch_plan_required with the plans link; buy the pass at POST /api/plans/:id. Answers 202 after activation; sources are checked in the background, with a six-hour refresh interval and shared caches. The existing page slot covers its discovered resource hosts, form destinations and its own DNS/CNAME. Existing PageSpeed quota also covers browser checks. Alerts identify changes and registry expiry at 30, 15 and 7 days. Missing expiry is unknown. No takeover test is made. Recheck current account, organization and paid right before collection and delivery.
